title.en: Ancient Chinese Science & the Four Great Inventions
title.zh: 中国古代科技与四大发明

clips.send: Printing: woodblock printing appeared in the Tang (the Diamond Sutra of 868 is the earliest dated printed book). In the Northern Song, Bi Sheng invented movable type; in the Yuan, Wang Zhen made wooden type.
clips.text: Printing: woodblock printing appeared in the Tang (the Diamond Sutra of 868 is the earliest dated printed book). In the Northern Song, Bi Sheng invented movable type; in the Yuan, Wang Zhen made wooden type.

clips.send: Impact: paper and printing spread knowledge; the compass made ocean voyages possible; gunpowder changed warfare. Marx wrote: “Gunpowder, the compass and the printing press were the three great inventions which ushered in bourgeois society.”
clips.text: Impact: paper and printing spread knowledge; the compass made ocean voyages possible; gunpowder changed warfare. Marx wrote: “Gunpowder, the compass and the printing press were the three great inventions which ushered in bourgeois society.”

clips.send: Here is a timeline from the Warring States to the Yuan. Each coloured band is a dynasty or period. We will place the four inventions on four rows.

clips.send: Paper: paper appeared in the Western Han. In the Eastern Han, Cai Lun improved papermaking with bark, hemp ends, rags and old fishing nets.
clips.text: Paper: paper appeared in the Western Han. In the Eastern Han, Cai Lun improved papermaking with bark, hemp ends, rags and old fishing nets.

clips.send: Sinan (south-pointing spoon). Warring States: the earliest direction finder. In the Warring States period people carved natural magnetite (lodestone) into a spoon-shaped “sinan”. Placed on a smooth plate, the spoon turns until its handle points SOUTH. The handle points south because the magnetised spoon lines up with the Earth’s magnetic field. Si-nan equals “in charge of south”: the HANDLE points south.
clips.text: Sinan (south-pointing spoon)。Warring States: the earliest direction finder。In the Warring States period people carved natural magnetite (lodestone) into a spoon-shaped “sinan”.。Placed on a smooth plate, the spoon turns until its handle points SOUTH.。The handle points south because the magnetised spoon lines up with the Earth’s magnetic field.。Si-nan = “in charge of south”: the HANDLE points south.

clips.send: Gunpowder: alchemists invented it; a mid-Tang book records the recipe, and by the end of the Tang it was used in war. In the Song and Yuan came fire arrows, the Southern Song fire lance and Yuan metal guns.
clips.text: Gunpowder: alchemists invented it; a mid-Tang book records the recipe, and by the end of the Tang it was used in war. In the Song and Yuan came fire arrows, the Southern Song fire lance and Yuan metal guns.

clips.send: Making a sheet of paper. Pulp, screen, dry, peel. ① Soak and cut the raw materials. ② Pound them into pulp. ③ Dip a bamboo screen into the pulp vat and lift out a thin wet layer. ④ Press and dry the sheets. ⑤ Peel off the finished paper. Paper replaced heavy bamboo slips and expensive silk as the main writing material. Papermaking later spread to Korea, Japan and the Arab world, and then to Europe through the Arabs. Drag the Papermaking slider through steps 1–5!

clips.send: Compass: in the Warring States people made the lodestone sinan. In the Northern Song the compass began to be used at sea, and by the Southern Song it was widely used.
clips.text: Compass: in the Warring States people made the lodestone sinan. In the Northern Song the compass began to be used at sea, and by the Southern Song it was widely used.

clips.send: Now the world (schematic map). Papermaking spread to Korea and Japan, reached the Arab world in the mid-8th century, and entered Europe through the Arabs in the 12th century.
clips.text: Now the world (schematic map). Papermaking spread to Korea and Japan, reached the Arab world in the mid-8th century, and entered Europe through the Arabs in the 12th century.

clips.send: In the Song and Yuan, the compass and gunpowder also reached Europe through the Arabs. Printing spread to Korea and Japan, and movable type in Europe came about 400 years after Bi Sheng.
clips.text: In the Song and Yuan, the compass and gunpowder also reached Europe through the Arabs. Printing spread to Korea and Japan, and movable type in Europe came about 400 years after Bi Sheng.

clips.send: Bronze direction plate. A smooth plate marked with 24 directions. The square plate is marked with 24 directions; 午 (wu) means due south and 子 (zi) due north. A smooth plate means low friction, so the spoon can turn freely. Try the Surface slider! The square plate with a round centre reflects the old idea “round heaven, square earth”. Rough plate equals the spoon gets stuck before it finds south.

clips.send: Floating compass needle. Northern Song: used for navigation. In the Northern Song, people magnetised steel needles artificially and made compasses such as the floating needle. Shen Kuo’s Dream Pool Essays describes several ways to mount a magnetic needle, including floating it on water. The compass began to be used at sea in the Northern Song and was widely used by the Southern Song; it later reached Europe through the Arabs. Lodestone spoon, magnetised needle, compass at sea.

clips.send: Clay movable type. Northern Song: invented by Bi Sheng. In the Northern Song (Qingli era), Bi Sheng invented movable-type printing. Each character was carved in mirror image on a small piece of sticky clay and baked hard in fire. Shen Kuo recorded the method in Dream Pool Essays. Movable type appeared about 400 years earlier than in Europe. Clay, carve mirrored, bake, set, ink, print, reuse.

clips.send: 指南针：战国时期出现了用天然磁石制成的司南；北宋时指南针开始用于航海，南宋时广泛使用。
clips.text: 指南针：战国时期出现了用天然磁石制成的司南；北宋时指南针开始用于航海，南宋时广泛使用。

clips.send: 火药：由炼丹家发明，唐朝中期的书中已有火药配方的记载，唐朝末年开始用于军事；宋元时出现了火箭、火球、南宋的突火枪和元朝的火铳。

clips.send: 铁板与铁范。把活字固定成版。在铁板上铺一层松脂、蜡和纸灰的混合物，把活字排在铁框（铁范）里。。用火烤热铁板使药剂熔化，再用平板压平，冷却后活字就固定住了。。印完再加热，活字就能取下重新使用。点“ 活字印刷”看演示！。两块铁板交替使用：一块印刷，一块排字，非常快。

clips.send: 造纸术：西汉时已经出现了纸；东汉时蔡伦用树皮、麻头、破布、旧渔网改进了造纸术。
clips.text: 造纸术：西汉时已经出现了纸；东汉时蔡伦用树皮、麻头、破布、旧渔网改进了造纸术。

clips.send: 抄纸成纸。打浆，抄纸，晒干，揭纸。①浸泡、切碎原料 ②舂捣成纸浆 ③用竹帘在纸浆槽里捞出一层薄薄的纸膜 ④压干、晒干 ⑤揭下成纸。。纸逐渐取代笨重的竹简和昂贵的缣帛，成为主要的书写材料。。造纸术先后传到朝鲜、日本和阿拉伯地区，又经阿拉伯人传到欧洲。。拖动“造纸工序”滑块，走完 1—5 步！

clips.send: 泥活字。北宋：毕昇发明。北宋庆历年间，毕昇发明了活字印刷术。。用胶泥刻成反字，每字一印，用火烧硬。。沈括在《梦溪笔谈》中记载了这一方法。活字印刷术比欧洲早约400年。。胶泥刻反字，火烧变坚硬，排版刷墨印，拆下还能用。

clips.send: 影响：造纸术和印刷术促进了文化传播；指南针为远洋航行提供了条件；火药改变了作战方式。马克思说：“火药、指南针、印刷术——这是预告资产阶级社会到来的三项伟大发明。”

clips.send: 印刷术：唐朝出现了雕版印刷（868年的《金刚经》是现存最早标有确切日期的印刷品）；北宋时毕昇发明活字印刷术；元朝王祯创制了木活字。

clips.send: 司南。战国时期：最早的指示方向的仪器。战国时期，人们用天然磁石琢磨成勺子形状的“司南”。。把它放在光滑的地盘上，勺子转动后停下来，勺柄指向南方。。勺柄指南，是因为磁化的勺子受地球磁场的作用。。“司南”就是“主管南方”：勺“柄”指南。
